Login.Description: Any email, and any password other than 'correct-password', triggers a server-driven error via Form.SetFieldError. Try clicking Log In with everything empty first - the button never disables just because the form looks invalid, only while it's actually submitting.

Signup.Header: Signup - two cross-field styles, side by side
Signup.Description: Both panels below validate that the confirmation matches the password, but via genuinely different mechanisms - see SignupViewModel's own remarks for why [Compare] only works in the left (schema) mode.
Signup.SchemaDescription: Form.FromModel<SignupModel>() - [Compare(nameof(Password))] on the model's own ConfirmPassword property.
Signup.AdHocDescription: No model class - Form.DefineField + Field.DependsOn + a hand-written rule that reads the password field's value directly.

Profile.Description: Every field and every rule here comes from ProfileEditModel's own DataAnnotations attributes via Form.FromModel - nothing is declared by hand.
Profile.Success: Profile saved - {0} is up to date.

CustomRules.Description: A single standalone Field<string> - two plain ValidationRule<T> delegates plus one AsyncValidationRule<T> that simulates a real 'is this taken?' API call. Type 'admin', 'root', 'test', or 'user' to see it fail after a short delay - watch 'Checking...' appear while it's in flight.
CustomRules.Taken: '{0}' is already taken - try admin/root/test/user to see this.

Showcase.Description: Every field below is rendered by FieldTemplateSelector, not hand-authored XAML - the control itself (a dropdown for Plan/Theme, a multi-line box for Notes, a plain box otherwise) is chosen per field from [UIHint]/[DataType], and the small gray line under each field is [Display(Prompt = "...")] - separate guidance text, not a control choice. Try 'admin' (DeniedValues), a username starting with a digit (CustomValidation), an invalid phone/card number, or a country code that isn't 2 letters (Length) - then submit with something still invalid to see focus jump to the first broken field.

Validation.InvalidUrl: That doesn't look like a valid URL.
Validation.PasswordMinLength8: Password must be at least 8 characters.
Validation.DisplayNameTooLong: Display name must be 40 characters or fewer.
Validation.UsernameStartsWithDigit: Username cannot start with a digit.
Validation.InvalidPhone: That doesn't look like a valid phone number.
Validation.InvalidCreditCard: That doesn't look like a valid card number.
Validation.InvalidCountryCodeLength: Use a 2-letter country code, e.g. US or VN.
